# ZetaAI

> ZetaAI is an offline-first AI companion: chat, voice and an interactive avatar run entirely on your own device — no cloud, no account.

Key facts:

- Platforms: macOS, Windows, Linux, iOS and Android
- Price: free to download for personal use; no account, no subscription
- Runs fully offline: models ship with the app (≈ 1.2 GB; 8 GB RAM recommended)
- Features: interactive animated avatar, voice chat, private local conversations
- Privacy: nothing is sent away and conversations never leave the machine

## Links

- [Homepage](https://zeta.dream-team.works/): product overview, screenshots and download
